business_summary: Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides information and collection agency services in Japan. It offers solutions for data processing, systems integration, and software development, including integrated payment, payment acceptance, and settlement services, as well as information technology services. The company also provides cloud services; data entry works; digital and credit guarantee type payment services; payment processing system; computer system development, maintenance, operation, and quality inspection; information system planning, design, management, operation, and consulting; sales of computer-related equipment and peripherals; and worker dispatch business related to information processing. In addition, it is involved in the planning, development, operation, and sale of ASP systems for the oil sales industry; IT consulting; website design and construction; system design and construction; internet service management; internet information provision; import and sale of cybersecurity products; cybersecurity business consulting; and optical fiber, multimedia, data transfer systems. The company was formerly known as Densan System Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Densan System Holdings Co., Ltd. in July 2021. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.
